title: Migrate the remaining BFF main importers to the extracted production seams
not_changed: services/control-plane/bff/tests/test_bff_rebalance_proposals.py (already correctly scoped by a prior task; independently verified, no edit needed)
summary: Of the 11 declared test files, 5 are now fully migrated off services/control-plane/bff/main.py (zero import of main, zero sys.path mutation, zero bff_main monkeypatching): test_bff_mgmt_common_filters.py, test_bff_pm12_portfolio_book_contract.py, tests/test_overlay_retirement.py, tests/test_ppl_alloc_009_assertion_semantics.py, tests/test_ppl_alloc_012_ranking_projection.py. All 5 now exercise the real extracted production owner/router/service modules directly (capital/service.py, capital/router.py, agora/performance/service.py, management_read_models/ranking_router.py, personas/service.py, incidents/service.py, strategies/routes/common.py, core/app_factory.py), following the pattern already established and reviewer-approved in tests/test_remaining_main_seam_composition.py. The live AST-scanned non-whitelisted main-importer count dropped from 11 to 6, with the composition_allowlist left untouched (no allowlist expansion). The remaining 6 files (test_bff_mgmt_ai_persistence_2026_06_03.py, test_bff_mgmt_ops_006_operator_actions_contract.py, test_bff_promotion_review_governance.py, test_mgmt_load_005_read_concurrency.py, tests/test_bff_path_dedupe.py, tests/test_bff_rebalance_proposals.py) retain a narrowly scoped, documented main.py dependency because the specific behavior they exercise (the NL-ask handler and its audit deque; the command_adapter_service validator/precondition graph; the promotion-review ranking-write-owner and human-inbox decision-projection helpers; the read-isolation timeout wrapper, which is wired into only one of five routes this suite covers; the full ~30-router app assembly; and command-replay-on-startup plus the /bff/version payload computation) genuinely has no extracted owner anywhere else in the tree. None of these 6 files' behavior was faked, weakened, skipped, xfailed, or worked around by expanding the composition allowlist; each retained dependency is documented in-file with the specific missing symbol and why. Eliminating them requires further production-seam extraction out of main.py, which this task's acceptance criteria explicitly forbid touching -- that extraction work is left to a follow-up production-seam task feeding into BFF-TEST-FULL-MIGRATION-CORRECTIVE-001, per this task's own stated scope ('leaves final integrated migration evidence to BFF-TEST-FULL-MIGRATION-CORRECTIVE-001').

4 of ~15 tests exercise POST /bff/management/nl/ask; the handler plus _MGMT_AI_AUDIT_EVENTS / _management_ai_record_event / _mgmt_nl_command_idempotency_store exist only in main.py with no extracted owner module. Verified by repo-wide grep across services/control-plane/bff excluding main.py and test files. The remaining tests in this file no longer import main.
retained_composition_gaps.test_bff_mgmt_ops_006_operator_actions_c: main.py's module-level command_adapter_service instance (built from _VALIDATORS and the ops-console precondition graph: _enforce_ops_console_preconditions, _ops_read_model_entry_for_persona) has no extracted owner module; reproducing it would require duplicating that validator/precondition logic, which the acceptance criteria forbid.
retained_composition_gaps.test_bff_promotion_review_governance.py: The promotion-review/human-inbox surfaces require a real ranking_write_owner plus human-inbox decision-projection helpers (_human_inbox_decision_recommendation_id, _human_inbox_decision_projection_from_record) that exist only in main.py. personas/router.py::create_personas_router exists but the ranking-write-owner wiring needed to compose it correctly is not yet extracted. Two genuinely extracted symbols (_human_inbox_trusted_promotion_submission, human_inbox_surface_timeout_seconds) were migrated to their real owners (personas/service.py, governance/service.py) in this pass.
retained_composition_gaps.test_mgmt_load_005_read_concurrency.py: The bounded-executor read-isolation timeout wrapper (_run_management_read / _management_read_timeout_seconds) exists only in main.py and, in the current composition, is wired into only one of the five routes this suite exercises (incidents/router.py's /bff/alerts, via its run_management_read param); the other four routes (/bff/management/evidence, /bff/jobs, /bff/approvals, /bff/management/human-inbox) call their services directly with no timeout/offload wrapper in the current production wiring.
retained_composition_gaps.tests/test_bff_path_dedupe.py: This suite asserts the fully-assembled production app (all ~30 mounted routers) has zero duplicate/shadowed routes. main.py is the only module in the tree that assembles the complete route table; core/app_factory.py::build_bff_app() intentionally mounts zero routers per its own module docstring ('The later main-assembly task will inject the existing domain handlers'). No other full-composition entrypoint exists anywhere in services/control-plane/bff (verified by grepping every FastAPI()/create_app/build_app definition in the tree).
retained_composition_gaps.tests/test_bff_rebalance_proposals.py: Pre-existing, unchanged by this task (already correctly scoped by a prior task): 2 of ~35 tests need main.py's own _process_command_stub (startup command-replay orchestration, coupled to main.py's module globals) and the /bff/version route's real payload computation (the route shell is extracted into core/app_factory.py, but the computation itself is not); neither has an extracted owner. Verified via independent baseline diff that this file is byte-identical to base.
